title: Momino Mein Hai Hashr Sa Bapa Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer e Sadiq
body:
Momino Mein Hai Hashr Sa Bapa. , Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
moosa E Kazim Asws. Karte Hai Buka, Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
1. Zulm Na Ruka Zalimeen Ka Ghar Jala Diya Wa Museebata.
haaye Dediya Zehre La Dawa Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Madraso Ki Shaan Ilm O Fan Ki Jaan Kibriyai Ki Jo Hai Aan Baan.
baab Ilm Ka Haaye Dhaa Diya, Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaan Boojhkar Saamne Layee'n Jad Ko Aapke Kehte The Bura.
chain Se Tumhe Jeene Na Diya, Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Zeher Ka Asar Is Qadar Hua, Zard Hogaya Chehra Aapka.
zeher Saqt Tha Zabt Na Hua, Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ta Dame Naza, Saath Hai Pisar, Karte Hai Buka Sar Ko Peetkar.
yaad Aagayi Unko Karbala, Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Seenazan Hai Aaj Asghari Tamam, Yeh Kumail Ki Hai Dua Imam.
ho Baqi Mein Bhi Aapki Aza, Kar Gaye Qaza Jaffer E Sadiq Asws.
